## Deferrals read
Read `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` first. Dispositions:
- **DF-S1.5-1** — dated progress note added (2026-09-19): the Stage-2
  ledger op surface is now landed — `fork`/`navigate`/`rollback` ops,
  `forked_from` anchor verification, `head.moved` + live `Rewind`
  frames, GC `Pinned{referenced_by_run}` against fork prefixes.
  Remaining per the row's wording: tiered retention policies
  (hot/warm/cold) and compression at rest — carried to DF-S2.9-1 (no
  Stage-2 ticket owns the policy surface).
- **DF-S2.4-1 member (c)** — dated progress note added (2026-09-19):
  the protocol `fork` exists, but `rebind_credentials_for_fork` stays
  unwired — `EmbedService` holds no `CredentialBroker`; the custody
  seam stays open under that row.
- **DF-S2.9-1 (new, OPEN)** — the S3.6 (`⁰ᵇ`) halves: replay driver,
  `ReplayValidityReport`, counterfactual hook, plus the tiered-
  retention/compression-at-rest carry-over.
- **DF-S2.9-2 (new, OPEN)** — the strict `CoverageInsufficient`
  refusal posture (S2.9 always downgrades-and-records).
- **DF-S2.9-3 (new, OPEN)** — the snapshot producer cadence (nothing
  takes `fs_tree` snapshots on a real run; `fork{env: snapshot}` on an
  unsnapshotted run is the honest `SnapshotUnavailable`).

## Requirements

| id | deliverable | state |
|---|---|---|
| R-2.2.4⁰ᵃ coherent fork points | `check_fork_point`/`coherent_fork_points`/`nearest_coherent_seq` projections + `ForkPointNotCoherent{open_scopes}`; exposed as the `coherent_fork_points` op | landed (S2.3 substrate) — wired + covered at S2.9 (`s2_9_coherent_fork_points_and_shared_live_refusal`) |
| inter-run `fork` | `Store::fork` opens the child under `open_run` with `forked_from{run_id, at_seq, head_hash}` bound at the (possibly coerced) cut; `lifecycle.run.forked{BranchRecord}` minted on the child; `fork` op resolves `at` by seq or `{run_id, event_id}` event-ref (inter-run by construction) | landed — `crates/hh-ledger/src/branch.rs::Store::fork`, `crates/hh-embed/src/work.rs::fork` |
| `fs_tree` snapshots | `snapshot_for` (newest `at_seq ≤ cut`, record blob via `manifest_ref`, ref re-derived on decode); `derive_from_snapshot` materialises the child workspace from blob content — never the parent's live tree; `restore_in_place` for rollback | landed — `hh-env/src/driver.rs`, `hh-helper/src/fstree.rs`, `hh-env/src/snapshot.rs` |
| `rollback` | coherent-cut gate → `compensate_run_after(at)` (reverse commit order, `~comp` ids, escalation on failure) → rewind-note blob (`record_ref`) → `lifecycle.run.rolled_back` → `lifecycle.head.moved` + `Rewind`; `uncompensable`/`uncaptured` named, never dropped | landed — `branch.rs::Store::rollback`, `saga.rs::compensate_run_after` |
| `fork`/`navigate`/`rolled_back` events + lineage + HEAD navigation | `lifecycle.run.forked`/`lifecycle.run.rolled_back`/`lifecycle.head.moved` registered in the class table with audit partitions; `navigate` moves the *logical* head — WAL stays dense (`wal_tip_seq`/`wal_tip_hash` chain every append); `read` serves the whole prefix; rebuild replays the same `fold_head` | landed — `store.rs` (fold_head, commit/rebuild parity), `classes.rs`, `branch.rs::navigate` |
| subscription rewind frames | `EventFrame::Rewind` → public `Frame::Rewind{to_seq, to_event_id, reason}` at `durability: ephemeral`; the `head.moved` durable row streams alongside | landed — `hh-embed/src/frames.rs`, `hh-embed-schema/src/frames.rs` |
| GC pinning + redaction tombstones | the `forked` envelope `refs` carry every content address the source prefix references + the snapshot blob; `pin_reason` honours cross-run refs → `Pinned{referenced_by_run}`; tombstones unchanged (`Missing{gc|redacted}`) | landed — `branch.rs` pin set + `ac_2_2_4_8_*` tests |
| rebuildable derived index | `Store::branch_tree` + `views::branch_tree` fold `run.forked`/`rolled_back` rows into `BranchInfo{record, head_seq, rolled_back, children}` — a projection, never a store | landed — `branch.rs`, `views.rs::branch_tree` |

## Known seams / residual

- `EnvBinding::None` — an absent `env` member records `none` (no env
  bound; the child provisions later — the pre-S2.9 posture). `snapshot`
  is opt-in and refuses `SnapshotUnavailable` without a snapshot.
- `fork` does not yet call `rebind_credentials_for_fork` — no
  `CredentialBroker` on `EmbedService` (DF-S2.4-1 member (c) note).
- `CoverageInsufficient` is declared but unused — the ladder always
  downgrades-and-records (DF-S2.9-2).
- No snapshot cadence exists — `fork{env: snapshot}` needs a test-or-
  op-taken snapshot (DF-S2.9-3).
